text:
mavi: FYI ap-southeast GPU warm-pool nodes failing KMS decrypt during join (since 02:11 UTC). Getting AccessDenied on key arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:...:key/0a1b2c.

leo: Confirmed. Recent subnet-scoped condition on the key requires tag `env=prod` on ENI; warm-pool uses `env=warm`.

tasha: Ouch. This blocks ~30 nodes from joining, autoscaler stuck. If we flip the key condition we'll need security signoff and an incident tag.

ops-bot: keystore-proxy returning 502->kms (count 28 in 10m).

mavi: Short term options: 1) add `env=warm` to key condition; 2) temp alias with relaxed tags; 3) move warm-pool subnet to match tag (harder). Recommend (1) + audit tag and rollback window.

leo: I can patch policy in staging now and prod after 10m canary. Will add `incident:7012345678` tag.

finance-bot: Note: estimated extra audit events ~6k for 90m -> cost ~$0.80. Tagging will help billing.

tasha: Security, please approve 2hr emergency exception. Document rollback step.

mavi: Opening INC-701234. I'll record diff and schedule rollback at +90m. Monitoring join logs.

leo: Pushed key policy change to staging; canary nodes joined. Rolling to prod now.

mavi: Prod patch applied. 24/30 nodes joined, autoscaler recovered. Will close when warm-pool drained and policy reverted.

ops-bot: alert cleared: keystore-proxy error rate back to normal.

mavi: Marking resolved. Postmortem will recommend tagging warm-pool ENIs earlier in provisioning pipeline to avoid KMS condition race.
